components_touched.name: app/not-found.tsx
components_touched.summary: Next.js special file to intercept 404 errors. It will use the site's standard layout by virtue of being in the app directory, but we must ensure it fits the design.

deferred_decisions: Specific copy for the 'helpful explanation' (SWE to use a professional, simple tone as per BA spec).
rationale:
The implementation uses Next.js's convention for 404 pages by creating `app/not-found.tsx`. Since `app/layout.tsx` wraps all children in the `ThemeProvider` and provides the `header` and `Footer`, the new 404 page will automatically inherit the site's structure and theme capabilities.

I have mapped the visual requirements to the existing design patterns found in `app/page.tsx`:
- Backgrounds: `bg-zinc-50 dark:bg-black` or `bg-white dark:bg-black`.
- Text: `text-black dark:text-zinc-50` for headings, `text-zinc-600 dark:text-zinc-400` for body.
- Primary Button: `bg-foreground text-background` (as seen in the Vercel deploy button).

The 404 page will be a functional component that implements a centered hero layout.

## Memory writes
- decision: Use `app/not-found.tsx` for custom 404 handling to leverage Next.js built-in routing.
- decision: Re-use the design system from `app/page.tsx` (zinc color palette and foreground/background button styles) to ensure visual consistency.
- constraint: The 404 page must be accessible via keyboard and screen readers using semantic HTML.

risks.mitigation: Verify that the page inherits the ThemeProvider correctly via the RootLayout and uses standard Tailwind classes to avoid flash of unstyled content (FOUC).
risks.risk: The custom 404 page might not inherit the dark mode correctly if it attempts to bypass the RootLayout.

risks.mitigation: Ensure semantic HTML (h1, p, button/a) is used.
risks.risk: Accessibility regressions if custom layout elements are not properly marked up.

swe_constraints: Use `app/not-found.tsx` to leverage Next.js's built-in 404 handling.
Style the page using the existing Tailwind tokens used in `app/page.tsx` (e.g., `zinc-600`, `zinc-400`, `zinc-950`, `zinc-50`).
Ensure the 'Return to Home' button uses the 'anz-blue' equivalent or the primary branding style seen in the current site. Based on `page.tsx`, primary actions use `bg-foreground text-background`.
The layout must be centered 'hero' style using `flex flex-col items-center justify-center`.
Must reside within the existing site wrapper (Header/Footer) provided by `layout.tsx`.
